full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Bruyères-le-Châtel data center with 13,800 Nvidia GPUs begins operations

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI entered the physical artificial intelligence market with the release of Robostral Navigate, its first robotics foundation model. The model uses cutting-edge AI-powered navigation to assist autonomous robots.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI launches Robostral Navigate, first robotics foundation model

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI expanded its offerings with a capable open-weight model integrated into Azure Local infrastructure. The expansion enables legally and physically isolated AI processing, aligning with escalating European regulatory pressure.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI launches open-weight model for Azure Local offline processing

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI reached $400M ARR as of July 2026, representing 4x growth from $100M ARR in 2025. The company achieved a $23B valuation with total funding of $5.5B across 6 rounds and 350 employees.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI achieves $400M ARR and $23B valuation

full_dated_event_log.Description: As of mid-2026, Mistral is rumored to be raising approximately $3.5 billion at a $23.15 billion valuation, nearly doubling its current valuation. This would be one of the largest funding rounds in European startup history.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI rumored to raise $3.5B at $23.15B valuation

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral released Robostral Navigate, a single-camera robot autonomy system powered by an 8B model. The system eliminates the need for LiDAR, depth sensors, or multiple cameras while delivering superior results on standard benchmarks. This positions Mistral at the forefront of embodied AI.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral Robostral Navigate single-camera robot autonomy system launch

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI launched its first robotics model as part of a push into physical AI. Further details about the model's specifications, pricing, or partnerships were not available from the article content provided.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI launches first robotics model targeting physical AI applications

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral announced Robostral Navigate, an 8-billion-parameter embodied navigation model designed for robotics. The model steers robots through unfamiliar indoor spaces using a single RGB camera and plain-language instructions.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral announces Robostral Navigate embodied navigation model

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI announced a new robotics navigation model as part of its push into physical artificial intelligence. The French startup is expanding into this emerging field following deals with major European industrial customers.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI releases robotics navigation model for physical AI expansion

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI released Robostral Navigate, an 8B embodied navigation model designed to enable robots to navigate complex environments using only a single RGB camera. The model achieves 76.6% performance on the R2R-CE benchmark.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI Releases Robostral Navigate 8B Embodied Navigation Model

full_dated_event_log.Description: French government commission recommends state participation in Mistral AI, classifying it as a strategic asset that equips state services. The recommendation is part of broader proposals addressing digital dependencies and includes a moratorium on foreign data centers.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: State Participation Proposed in Mistral AI as Strategic Asset

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI announced a strategic partnership with CI&T, a tech transformation leader, to integrate next-generation AI into enterprise operations. The partnership combines Mistral's open-weight LLM technology with CI&T's expertise in AI-driven transformation and agentic software development to accelerate AI adoption across industries.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral partners with CI&T to enable enterprise AI transformation

full_dated_event_log.Description: Swedish investment firm EQT is in talks to lead or co-lead French AI company Mistral's Series D funding round through the Scaleup Europe Fund. The fund has a €5bn commitment for this round.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: EQT in talks to lead Mistral Series D via Scaleup Europe Fund

full_dated_event_log.Description: Microsoft announced that Azure cloud customers can develop software using Mistral's data centers in France. The agreement provides Microsoft with increased capacity for AI customers in Europe and enables regulated industries to access non-U.S. infrastructure alternatives.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI signs multibillion-dollar infrastructure deal with Microsoft for European Azure capacity

full_dated_event_log.Description: Microsoft and Mistral announced an expanded AI partnership integrating Mistral's frontier and efficient models across Microsoft's platform including Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, and Azure. The partnership enables customers to build and run AI across multiple operating environments.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Microsoft and Mistral Expand AI Partnership with Sovereign Cloud and Azure Integration

full_dated_event_log.Description: Microsoft and Mistral announced a strategic partnership combining expanded Europe-based GPU capacity with new Mistral models integrated into Microsoft Foundry and Copilot Studio. The deal establishes a common deployment model spanning Azure's public cloud and customer-controlled Azure Local systems.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Microsoft-Mistral Deal Brings Sovereign AI to Azure Local

full_dated_event_log.Description: Samsung Electronics is in advanced talks to invest up to €1 billion (approximately $1.1 billion) in Mistral AI. The investment values the French AI startup at roughly €20 billion.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Samsung Electronics invests up to $1.1B in Mistral AI

full_dated_event_log.Description: Samsung is in talks to invest in French foundational model company Mistral at a potential €20 billion valuation, as reported by the FT. The discussions are taking place amid market turbulence following the release of Kimi K3 by Moonshoot.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Samsung in talks to invest in Mistral at €20B valuation

full_dated_event_log.Description: Samsung Electronics announced investment in Mistral AI as part of a new funding round. The investment values Mistral AI at approximately €20 billion ($22.8 billion), with Samsung potentially investing around €1 billion.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Samsung to invest €1 billion in Mistral AI at €20 billion valuation

full_dated_event_log.Description: Samsung is reportedly considering a €1 billion investment in Mistral, a French AI lab. The investment would value Mistral at approximately €20 billion as Europe pursues sovereign AI initiatives.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Samsung Weighs €1 Billion Investment in Mistral AI

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI, alongside Nvidia and other industry players, urged Washington policymakers to avoid broad restrictions on open-weight AI models. The lobbying effort comes as the US government debates how to respond to Chinese AI development and alleged model distillation practices.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral urges US policymakers against broad open-weight AI restrictions

full_dated_event_log.Description: Microsoft commits multibillion dollars to expand Mistral's Europe-based GPU infrastructure and integrate Mistral models into Microsoft enterprise products. Mistral Medium 3.5 and OCR 4 are now available in Microsoft Foundry, with Mistral Medium 3.5 also integrated into Microsoft Copilot Studio.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Microsoft and Mistral expand strategic partnership with multibillion dollar commitment

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral released Shieldstral, a 3-billion-parameter open-weights multimodal safety classifier on August 4, 2026. The model reframes content moderation as a question-answering task rather than a fixed-taxonomy classification problem.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral releases Shieldstral 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral released Shieldstral, a 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier that converts moderation into policy-adaptive question answering. The tool handles both text and images, returns calibrated safety scores, runs on a single 16GB GPU, and is distributed under Apache 2.0 license.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral releases Shieldstral safety classifier

full_dated_event_log.Description: Mistral AI has raised approximately $4 billion to date according to PitchBook data, reaching a valuation of roughly $23 billion. This compares to Anthropic, currently the world's most valuable AI startup at $965 billion, more than 40 times Mistral's valuation.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI reaches $23 billion valuation after raising ~$4 billion

full_dated_event_log.Description: An article from Fortune references Mistral AI in the context of Washington's private AI model evaluation framework, which was reviewed with major labs including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Microsoft. Smaller AI labs expressed dissatisfaction with the lack of transparency around the rulebook. Mistral's specific role or position is not elaborated upon in the available content.
full_dated_event_log.Event Title: Mistral AI mentioned in context of Washington AI policy debate
